title: The Hanging Garden
text: Fruit hangs from vines with no tree to hold them, heavy and gold, swaying a little in air that does not move. The smell of it is a summer none of you remember living, but all of you miss. Juice drips from the ripest and hisses where it lands.

options.label: Eat the golden fruit, and taste the summer it promises.

outcomes.text: It tastes of every good year they have known. Something within them begins to grow, slow and green.
A heavy drowsiness follows the first bite. They are still yawning when the next fight finds them.

options.label: Pass beneath it without touching. Fruit with no tree is no gift.

outcomes.text: The vines sway as you pass beneath them. Their scent clings to the Leader, who dreams sweetly of that lost summer for days.
